record.title: Erenhot Zamyn Uud road freight stopped during COVID outbreak
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.direction: Initial reopening China to Mongolia only
record.exceptions: Rail traffic operated under different arrangements; no full rail closure inferred.
record.enforcement: Transport bulletin reports outbound cargo January 11; official inspection confirms broader freight restoration January 27.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence; present status not inferred
record.uncertainty: October 13–14 onset conflict remains. A December 8 border-area container trial and documented December 11 goods/vehicle admissions establish an earlier partial endpoint, bounded December 8–11. January 11, 2022 is later regular-container resumption, not the first partial road opening. Passenger and rail policies are distinct.

historical.duration_note: No justified exact-date continuous interval; contested onset and directional scope mismatch.

claim_checks.Historical note — current findings are i: Trade reporting and subsequent official restoration establish a road-cargo stoppage.

October 14 in Mysteel explicitly concerns Mongolia-to-China road movement; October 13 in UB Post concerns shortages of imports into Mongolia. The directional accounts may describe different starts; one common exact onset is not justified.
Substantial indexed IRU/UNECE text describes January 11 reopening only from China to Mongolia. January 27 official reporting describes fuller restoration.

Hierarchical coding: see Rationale coding for subcategories, attribution and phases. The recorded rationale and claim assessment support the selected subcategories. All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): COVID prevention is explicit.
This concerns road freight, not railway or passenger traffic. The original onset evidence and the calculated interval describe different directions.
The 89-day China-to-Mongolia interval lacks a matching exact onset. Remove that interval; this does not itself prove a temporary reopening or interruption within the spell.
